2608.30910.title: S3C-LLM: Skill-Code Guided Agentic Language Models for Spectrum-to-Structure Elucidation
2608.30910.paper_summary: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation. Although this paradigm can leverage paired spectral data, it does not explicitly model the analytical workflow used by spectroscopists, such as diagnostic peak interpretation, fragment reasoning, formula constraints, and chemical consistency checking. In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation. Rather than directly predicting a molecule, S3C-LLM retrieves modality-specific spectroscopy skills, executes analysis code to instantiate these skills on the input spectra, and integrates the resulting peak-level evidence and formula constraints before generating SMILES. Specifically, we contribute a self-evolving spectroscopy skill library, a thinking-augmented skill-code trajectory construction pipeline, and a two-stage training strategy that teaches Qwen3-4B through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by our proposed step-level reinforcement learning (RL). Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that S3C-LLM consistently outperforms current general LLMs and spectrum-specific models across spectra, while using less than 1/10th of SpectraLLM's training corpus.
2608.30910.paper_summary_zh: 光譜結構闡明是分子分析的核心，但最近基於大型語言模型（LLM）的方法大多將其表述為直接的光譜到SMILES生成。雖然這一範式可以利用配對的光譜數據，但並未明確建模光譜學家所使用的分析工作流程，例如診斷峰解釋、片段推理、公式約束和化學一致性檢查。在本文中，我們介紹了S3C-LLM，一個以技能引導和代碼為基礎的代理型LLM，用於光譜到結構的闡明。S3C-LLM並不是直接預測一個分子，而是檢索特定模態的光譜學技能，執行分析代碼以在輸入光譜上實現這些技能，並在生成SMILES之前整合結果的峰級證據和公式約束。具體而言，我們貢獻了一個自我演變的光譜學技能庫、一個思維增強的技能-代碼軌跡構建管道，以及一個兩階段的訓練策略，該策略通過監督微調（SFT）來教導Qwen3-4B，然後是我們提出的步驟級增強學習（RL）。在多樣的基準測試中實驗表明，S3C-LLM在光譜上始終超越當前的一般LLM和光譜特定模型，同時使用的訓練語料庫少於SpectraLLM的1/10。
